neighbours.label: the token ' are' in existential 'there are' (weaker for ' were' and for plain ' are')
fire: In the old town there are three bakeries on one street.
On this small island there are no cars at all.
Inside the box there are four spare batteries and a cable.
Today there are fewer farms in the valley than before.
I think there are better ways to solve this problem.
Along the coast there are many small fishing villages.
Right now there are two seats left on the bus.
Sadly, there are no tickets left for Friday's show.
quiet: In the old town the bakeries are all on one street.
On this small island the cars are all electric.
Inside the box the batteries are still sealed in plastic.
Today there is only one farm left in the valley.
I think these are better ways to solve this problem.
Along the coast the villages are small and quiet.
Right now we are waiting for the next bus.
Sadly, there is no ticket left for Friday's show.

notes: Card flags the pole as broad (1.2%) with the gate-closed regime at 60%. Probe: 'there are' 0.67, 'there were' 0.31, 'there is' 0.26, plain 'are' 0.12-0.16, 'area' 0.07. 'there is' sits near the 0.30 near-miss bar, so only two near misses use it.
